promotion_review.reviewer: Coding agent inspecting the actual changed component PNGs and all six actual assembly PNGs
promotion_review.scope: Software artwork review; not a human game observation
promotion_review.revision: Narrow terminal asphalt mouths with retained routes, interfaces, ownership, and adaptive resource mechanism
promotion_review.trumpet_reference_comparison: All six roles match the previously opened canonical HSR trumpet reference set, with current highway names, models, textures, positions, rotations, and heights.
checks: Headers, purpose subtitles, cameras, north/east compass, fixed X/Y city grid, complete model framing, and quiet software footer retain the corresponding trumpet presentation.
All fifteen placements retain full exact menu-name side cards, positions, counterclockwise rotations, coloured P-label badges, and matching leaders without clipped cards.
Clean views omit component cards, P-label badges, and leaders.

The construction view uses actual model geometry beneath 30 percent ownership fills, opaque grid and labels, thick occupied-tile boundaries, separate coloured actual-model outlines including overhang, and reference diamonds.
The four narrower ground driveway mouths and their retained six-metre grade joins are visible in the actual saved model views; no sidewalk slab or simulated development variant is invented.

standalone_component_review.reviewer: Coding agent inspecting six changed full views and three changed thumbnails; all thirty-six unchanged PNGs match the previously inspected bytes at commit 92cd22e.
checks: The crossing and both terminal angled/top pictures and thumbnails show the complete saved models with the revised ground openings and narrow pavement, readable captions, independent grids, and no clipping.
The remaining twelve component sets retain exactly the reviewed image bytes while all fifteen per-view reports bind the fresh measured DAT and current title sources.
Top pictures retain the authored zero-degree north-up presentation, complete real overhang, and the shared bright-green city-grid overlay.
